entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand GPS Tracker.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your name and the order number?
Sarah Jenkins. Order is 99425-B. Just tell me if you can process the return or not.

Of course, Ms. Jenkins. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order was delivered on December 15th. To make sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
There's no issue with it. I just couldn't deal with it. I had a medical emergency right after I got it and was in the hospital. I just got out.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope you're recovering well. We understand that unexpected life events happen, whether it's an emergency surgery or a sudden military deployment.
Right. So can I return it or not?

Yes, absolutely. Let me just double-check our return policy here... Okay, I'm looking at your purchase date. Our policy states that items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. You are unfortunately outside that window.
Great. So you're processing a full refund?

That's correct. I've just initiated the return authorization. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, the full refund will be credited back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
Okay, got the email. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Ms. Jenkins. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
